description: Welcome to 31 Alma Street, Paddington; a Big House Little House designed residence where luxury, functionality, and family living unite in a prestigious inner-city setting. Spread across two generous levels, this home boasts open-plan living and entertaining spaces, while the sparkling pool and manicured gardens create a private oasis for all ages.

Beautifully finished with high-end inclusions and a focus on comfort, the home offers an effortless lifestyle just 2.5km from the CBD, metres from both the Latrobe Terrace and Rosalie Village dining & boutique precincts, and only moments to Suncorp Stadium and parklands.
At a glance:
- Generous 430sqm allotment
- Big House Little House designed residence with high-end finishes and contemporary interiors
- Oak timber flooring throughout with high ceilings and plenty of windows and natural light throughout
- Downstairs level features open-plan living, dining and kitchen spaces flowing out to an entertainer's deck
- Gourmet kitchen with stone benchtops, custom cabinetry, double ovens, integrated fridge and freezer and a Butler's Pantry
- Living room also features a gas fireplace, perfect for the winter months
- Covered read deck with a large gas BBQ and natural gas outlets for outdoor heating
- The outdoor space also includes a sparkling salt-water swimming pool, landscaped gardens, and secure rear lawn perfect for children or pets
- Large study located off the kitchen with a built-in-wardrobe that could also function as a kid's playroom
- All bedrooms are located upstairs with the Main bedroom suite including a walk-in robe, luxury ensuite and a Juliette balcony that overlooks the leafy garden and swimming pool below
- All bedrooms include built-in-wardrobes and ducted air-conditioning
- The large second living room includes a front deck and also functions as the fifth bedroom
- Ducted and zoned air-conditioning throughout
- Double car secure garaging with internal access and ample storage throughout
A home of this calibre is rare and will not last long. Contact Michael Kleimeyer on 0401 691 631 or Harriet Went on 0438 153 868 today to arrange your inspection!
